site.name: EN ROUTE
site.tagline: Everyday life, distant places, and moments I don't want to forget.
about: Sometimes I press the shutter not because the view is extraordinary, but because the light, a sound, or a feeling is worth keeping.
This is a collection of roads I've taken, and ordinary days close to home. There is no hurry to arrive, or to find meaning in every photograph.
When I return to these pictures someday, I hope I'll still remember the breeze.

a-quiet-morning.title: Still morning, beyond the mountains
a-quiet-morning.alt: Mountains reflected in a still lake, with a small wooden cabin on the shore
body: I woke early and walked along the water. The mountains were still reflected perfectly in the lake.
With no next stop in mind, I stayed a little longer.

into-the-green.title: A little lighter on my feet
into-the-green.alt: Sunlight passing through a green forest, lighting the tree trunks and a woodland path
body: The air grew cooler as soon as I stepped into the shade.
I didn't take many photographs along the way. This one was taken when I stopped to listen to the wind.

after-the-tide.title: An afternoon of doing nothing
after-the-tide.alt: Blue-green waves stretching into the distance, where sea and sky meet at the horizon
body: The tide came in, again and again, then slowly drew back.
Only when the shadows grew long did I notice how much time had passed.

a-path-without-a-name.title: A path without a name
a-path-without-a-name.alt: A clear river running through tall trees, with mountain peaks visible in the distance
body: On a whim, I changed direction and turned onto an unfamiliar path.
There was no destination. Wherever I ended up would do.

the-long-way-home.title: The longer way home
the-long-way-home.alt: Layered mountains rising above a green valley that stretches into the distance
body: I'd been rushing on the way there. On the way back, I decided to slow down.
Some views, it turns out, are just beyond the turn you almost passed.

before-the-city-wakes.title: A little further, after dark
before-the-city-wakes.alt: A city street at night, with headlights and illuminated windows between tall buildings
body: After dinner, I didn't go straight home. I walked a little further along the lit-up streets.
The same road feels like two different places by day and by night.

august-note.title: Leave some space, too
body: While sorting through photographs, I realized my favorites aren't always the sharpest ones.
Sometimes it's just a blurred figure or an unlit window. Perhaps memories don't need to be so clear.

a-small-list.title: Small things, lately
body: Moved the desk by the window. Finished a book I'd left unread for ages. Went for an evening walk without headphones.
Nothing much has happened. That's good, too.

july-rain.title: After the rain
body: After several days of rain, there was finally a little sunshine today.
It brought back that afternoon I spent walking in the woods.
july-rain.alt: Sunlight passing through a green forest
